subject: 90-day kickoff checkpoints & who-does-what
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena@oakridgehealth.com>, Samir Gupta <samir@oakridgehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: 90-day kickoff checkpoints & who-does-what

Hi Lena / Samir —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per our agreement, I’m sending a concise kickoff checklist that lays out week-by-week checkpoints for the first 90 days and who owns each item. The goal here is to keep the onboarding lightweight and to make responsibilities clear so we can hit the pilot SLA you requested.

Attached: Oakridge-90d-checkpoints.xlsx (structured timeline + owners) and a very early SOW draft for procurement review.

High-level proposed milestones (first pass):
- Week 0 (Provisioning): API keys, network allowlist, account provisioning — Owner: Redwood (Ben/Infra)
- Week 1–2 (Integration): Basic API integration, sample prompts, test vectors — Owner: Oakridge devs + Redwood SE (Jonas)
- Week 3–5 (Tune & Eval): Prompt tuning, eval pass, quality sign-off — Owner: Oakridge product + Redwood SE
- Week 6–9 (Scale & Resilience): Batching config, KV cache tuning, latency targets — Owner: Redwood Ops (Ben)
- Week 10–12 (Pilot Review): SLA metrics review, go/no-go decision, production cutover window — Joint owners

Requests for you (Lena):
1) Confirm who on your side will own integration day-to-day (name & email).
2) Any procurement constraints/dates we should lock into the SOW?
3) Are there internal blackout windows in July / August for change windows?

If that looks good I’ll propose a standing weekly 30-minute cadence (Wed 10am PT) for the first 6 weeks and route an internal handoff note to CS so they can prepare adoption resources.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0162

Attachments: Oakridge-90d-checkpoints.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redwood-SOW-draft.docx (docx)
From: Lena Park <lena@oakridgehealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir@oakridgehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: 90-day kickoff checkpoints & who-does-what

Rafael —

Thanks for the clear breakdown. Quick answers:
- Integration owner: Samir Gupta (samir@oakridgehealth.com) — he’ll be the day-to-day.
- Procurement: our standard PO process will need a signed SOW by August 6 to meet the Aug 15 budget cutover.
- Blackouts: July 20–22 we have a maintenance freeze for our platform; avoid major config changes then.

Two questions from my side:
1) Can Redwood commit to a latency baseline at pilot (p50 < 120ms for 512 tokens)?
2) For the Week 3 tune, do you provide a small evaluation harness or should we build our own test harness?

Lena
Director, Digital Experience
Oakridge Health

Lena —

Great — thanks Samir for stepping in as integration owner. Answers below: 

- Latency baseline: We can commit to targeting p50 < 120ms for 512-token requests on our Dedicated tier during pilot; I’ll include a performance SLA section in the SOW and a fallback plan if we miss targets during the pilot.

- Evaluation harness: Redwood will provide a lightweight evaluation harness (Python + curl examples, plus a small set of sample vectors) that Jonas will help run with your team during Week 3. If you have internal metrics to validate quality (F1/accuracy / acceptance prompts), share them and we’ll integrate.

Next steps I’ll take this week:
1) Update the spreadsheet with the August 6 SOW deadline and July blackout.
2) Draft the performance clause and sample acceptance criteria.
3) Schedule the Wed 10am PT standing meeting starting July 14 (unless you prefer another time).

Assigning internal owners here: Ben will lead provisioning & network config; Jonas will be SE lead for integration; Monica will own post-pilot adoption playbook and CS handoff.

Rafael
